d7a562001dc82413.s: Remember that a lot of who you are, is your ability to experience things outside of yourself, *including other humans.* They are a direct and immediate part of your own reality. Treat their struggles and woes as if they were your own, don't leave people behind, don't leave people unloved. As frustrating as the world can be, it is worth protecting, it is worth loving, it is worth healing together.
d7a562001dc82413.t: 记住，你之为你的很大一部分，在于你能够体验自身之外的事物，*包括其他人*。他们直接而即刻地构成你自身现实的一部分。把他们遇到的挣扎与苦难当作你自己的挣扎与苦难来对待，不要抛下任何人，不要让人不被爱。世界纵然令人沮丧，它仍值得守护，值得去爱，值得一起疗愈。
